purpose: Teach: マルコ/スティーブ/フィリップ/ムーア/ファーム/ヨシ/アール/服部

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがイタリアでマルコ氏と知り合われた
lines.en: You know, Gran — when your father was young, he met a man named Marco in Italy.
lines.style: Soft, reminiscing tone. Gentle opening. Slow, measured pace. Eyes somewhere distant — not quite in the room. Warmth tinged with age and time.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、米国スティーブ氏と文通されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear — and when you were young, didn't you correspond with a man named Steve in America?
lines.style: Warm, playful tilt. Gentle teasing underneath. Knowing smile in the voice. Raises the last word slightly — a question that's also a tender point.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが英国フィリップ氏とジャズを聴かれた
lines.en: Gran, and when your father was young, he'd listen to jazz with a man named Philip from England.
lines.style: Still distant and reflective. Slight pause before each name — summoning the memory. Quieter than before. A thread of melancholy in the jazz reference.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、ロックスターのムーアさんの曲を愛されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you, dear — when you were young, didn't you absolutely love a rockstar named Moore's music?
lines.style: Knowing warmth. Gentle insistence. She's not asking, she's reminding. Small laugh underneath the words. The affection of someone keeping their partner's history alive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは野球のファーム選手にも詳しかった
lines.en: Gran, and when your father was young, he knew quite a lot about minor league baseball players.
lines.style: Same reflective distance. A slight shift — this memory feels smaller, more intimate. Still slow. Voice trails a bit, as if wondering why this detail matters so much.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、ヨシ、つまりヨッシーのキャラクターをお孫様と楽しまれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And didn't you, dear — when you were young, enjoy those Yoshi characters with your grandchildren?
lines.style: Bright, tender memory. Voice lifts slightly with affection. Playful — teasing him gently about how he loved playing with the grandkids. Warm and present.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが漫画のアール、つまりRをモチーフにした絵を描かれた
lines.en: Gran, your father — when he was young — he used to draw pictures inspired by a character called R from manga.
lines.style: The wistfulness deepens. Slower still. Slight wonder in discovering how particular, how specific these memories are. Voice becomes almost fragile — the weight of all these small moments.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、服部半蔵の歴史小説を愛読されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you, dear — when you were young — didn't you just devour those historical novels about Hattori Hanzō?
lines.style: Tender close. Warm, knowing smile. The final beat of a conversation they've had a thousand times. Voice settles gently, like a benediction. Small and intimate.
